subject: Capacity shepherding: Triton Labs late-stage POC GPU matrix
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity check request for Triton POC - estimated matrix attached

Team —

Late-stage POC with Triton Labs (deal id TRIT-POC-4721) just surfaced a deterministic start window: they want a 3-week pilot beginning the week of Oct 11. They're asking for a dedicated block that approximates the following steady-state profile:~

- 6x A100-80GB-equivalent (for model benchmarking)
- 12 concurrent < 8k token sessions that will drive high KV-cache pressure
- Burst requirement: additional 4 A100 equivalents for 6-hour peak windows (~2x/day)

I've attached their demand profile (triton_demand_profile_v2.xlsx) and a quick ask: can ops confirm whether we can offer a soft hold on equivalent capacity in us-west for a 14-day window (soft hold = reserve visible internally but not billed until PO/commit)? Need a yes/no and any caveats (e.g., alternative quantized SKUs, preemptible constraints) by EOD so I can communicate timelines to Samira.

If we can't meet exact A100 inventory, outline closest equivalent (H100, multi-node pooling) and any perf delta I should include in the MLP.

Thanks —
Rishi
Sr. Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: triton_demand_profile_v2.xlsx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity check request for Triton POC - estimated matrix attached

Rishi —

Quick inventory snapshot attached (fleet_snapshot_20270929.csv). Short answer: we have the equivalent of ~8 A100 slots available in us-west today and another ~6 H100-capable slots that can be carved into A100-equivalent using quantized fallback images, but there are two constraints:~

1) Those H100 nodes are currently earmarked for a different confidential proof; we can release up to 4 if the other team confirms flexibility.
2) Autoscaling for the concurrent sessions will need to be bounded — the KV-cache pressure you mentioned will blow past latency SLOs unless we enable prefix caching and increase the instance size for the central shards. That means a minor config change and a short regression sanity run (~4 hours).

Recommend:
- Place a 14-day soft hold for 6 A100-equivalent immediate + 4 A100-equivalent burst (total soft hold 10 equivalent units).
- Block the H100 nodes as contingent reserve (releaseable on confirmation) so we have runway to convert if they sign.

If you want, I can make the soft hold in ReserveBoard now and tag it TRIT-POC-4721; someone from Sales needs to confirm willingness to accept a quantized fallback in writing if we end up using H100->A100-equivalent translation.

Connor
Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: fleet_snapshot_20270929.csv)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity check request for Triton POC - estimated matrix attached

Thanks Connor — this is helpful.

Let's do the soft hold you suggested: 6 A100-equivalent immediate + 4 burst (10 total) for 14 days. Connor, please create the ReserveBoard hold and flag it as \"sales-soft-hold: TRIT-POC-4721\". Include the contingency note about H100 fallback and call out the regression sanity run requirement.

Lauren — once the soft hold is posted, please create the internal ticket to surface the potential perf delta to Solutions (cc: Neha). I want the external message to Triton to be explicit that we have reserved capacity and that we will proceed to finalize perf validation and an optional quantized fallback plan pending their PO.

I'll draft the external note to Samira after you confirm the hold is live.

Rishi
Sr. Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 12:05:00 -07:00

All —

Hold created in ReserveBoard: RB-87214
- Soft hold: 6 A100-equivalent (immediate) + 4 A100-equivalent (burst)
- Hold window: 14 days (2027-09-29 through 2027-10-13)
- Tags: sales-soft-hold, TRIT-POC-4721, contingent-H100

Subject: Redwood capacity update for Triton Labs POC (soft hold placed)

Samira —

Quick update from our side after the sizing exercise you shared: we've placed a 14-day internal soft hold on capacity on behalf of Triton Labs (reference TRIT-POC-4721). Summary:~

- Soft hold: 6 A100-equivalent immediate + 4 A100-equivalent burst (visible internally; not billed)
- Hold reference: RB-87214
- We will run a short regression sanity run (OPS-2917) to validate prefix caching and the perf delta for the fallback quantized path if needed.

Two notes for your team:~
1) If you plan to sign and start the pilot the week of Oct 11, please confirm the PO intent by Oct 6 so we can convert the hold to reserved capacity and lock in the instance types.
2) If the PO requires strict A100 hardware (no fallback), let us know now — we may need an extra 7–10 days of lead time to re-prioritize the confidential proof block Connor referenced.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call this afternoon if you want to walk through the hold and timeline.

Best —
